action.login: Sign in with email and password

fallback.title: Sign in failed
fallback.text: Try again. If this continues, tell whoever runs the server.

provider_denied.title: Sign in cancelled
provider_denied.text: The provider did not grant access. Try again, or use email and password.

invalid_request.title: Incomplete response from the provider
invalid_request.text: The response is missing data. Try again from the provider button.

invalid_state.title: Invalid sign in request
invalid_state.text: The request expired or started in another browser. Try again from this browser.

exchange_failed.title: The provider did not complete sign in
exchange_failed.text: Try again shortly. If this continues, use email and password or tell an administrator.

email_unverified.title: Email not verified
email_unverified.text: The provider does not confirm your email. Verify it in your provider account, then try again.

email_in_use.title: This email already has an account
email_in_use.text: The account has a password and the email is not verified, so the provider cannot link to it. Sign in with email and password.

identity_conflict.title: Provider linked to another profile
identity_conflict.text: Your account already uses another profile from this provider. Sign in with that profile, or with email and password.

registration_closed.title: Registration is closed
registration_closed.text: No account uses this email and new users are not accepted. Ask an administrator to create your account.

setup_required.title: The first administrator is missing
setup_required.text: You create the first account with the setup code, not with a provider.

account_disabled.title: Account disabled
account_disabled.text: Ask an administrator to reactivate it.

server_error.title: Server error
server_error.text: Sign in failed. Try again shortly. If this continues, tell whoever runs the server.
